_note: Curated from the eval reports produced this development cycle. Numbers are measured, not asserted. Source reports: evals/GOLD_REVIEW.md, evals/accept-set-audit.md, evals/v3.1-to-v3.2-report.md, evals/opus-vs-sonnet-report.md, evals/retrieval-diagnostic.md, evals/verifier-eval-report.md.

gold_set.sourcing: Every gold answer is grounded in a CBP CROSS binding ruling or unambiguous HTS text. No answer is asserted from model judgment.

prompt_evolution.result: ~50% top-1 @ 8-digit; GRI labels collapsed to mostly '1'.

prompt_evolution.change: Numbered decision procedure (Steps 1-4), forced verbatim chapter-note quotes, broker-relevance confidence rubric, hts_code written last.
prompt_evolution.result: 57.5% top-1 @ 8-digit; GRI distribution diversified; high-confidence accuracy ~70%.

prompt_evolution.change: Specificity Rule for named 8-digit lines (bamboo / electric / smartphone).
prompt_evolution.result: Fixed bamboo + candle-stand cases but introduced 3 smartwatch false positives (~$10K phantom recoverable).

prompt_evolution.change: Rule-precedence ordering (notes > principal function > GRI 1 > specificity > residual) with a smartwatch carve-out.
prompt_evolution.result: Suppressed the smartwatch FPs; refund-finder precision 47% -> 58%, recall stable.

prompt_evolution.change: Honest 6-digit fallback: when the deciding attribute is absent from the description, commit to the 6-digit subheading at high confidence instead of guessing the 8-digit line. New precision_level field.
prompt_evolution.result: Current production prompt. 61.9% top-1 @ 8-digit on the post-audit gold; citation grounding 99%.

model_bakeoff.summary: Ran the full 97-case gold and the 3 sample refund files on Opus 4.7 vs Sonnet 4.5 — same prompt, retrieval, scorer. Opus is modestly stronger but ~5x the cost and it does not crack the hard cases.
model_bakeoff.decision: Kept Sonnet 4.5 as default. Opus rescued only 5-6 of 37 stubborn failures for ~5x cost; the next real win is retrieval, not a bigger model.

retrieval_diagnostic.summary: For each of the 37 audit-confirmed stubborn failures, checked whether the correct code was even in the top-50 retrieved candidates.
retrieval_diagnostic.takeaway: Roughly half the remaining errors are reasoning-bound (the answer was retrieved, the model picked wrong) and half are retrieval-bound (the correct line was never surfaced). Verifier and retrieval upgrades address near-disjoint case sets.

experiments.name: Same-model verifier
experiments.detail: A second Sonnet pass re-reading the predicted line's HTS text. Rescue:break ratio was 5:5 on the gold set — net zero — so it was not shipped as an always-on step.

experiments.name: CROSS-grounded verifier
experiments.detail: Queries the live CBP CROSS rulings database and checks the prediction against how CBP actually classified materially-similar articles. Brings new external evidence into the loop rather than a second opinion on the same context.
